items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I met Marl Morrow Young in -- it was 1932... we both graduated and went to Wilson Junior College and we've been knowing each other for -- you know, since I was wearing knickers.

ctx.x: Marl Morrow was in high school with you too?

Yes. Marl Morrow Young. I met Marl Morrow Young in -- it was 1932, when I first came out of grammar school. And then we both went through -- we both graduated and went to Wilson Junior College and we've been knowing each other for -- you know, since I was wearing knickers.
Was Marl Morrow playing then too?
